recommendation.summary: Put a human review step before any score, rank or decision about a person takes effect, log the recommendation beside the decision, and record the use on the system card.
alternatives: a human review step before any decision about a person takes effect, logged beside the recommendation
ToolPolicyGuard(require_approval=[...], approval_callback=...) when the decision is a tool
a confidence threshold routing low-confidence cases to review
Fairlearn or AIF360 evaluation of the scoring model

package.leaves_open: ToolPolicyGuard gates only a decision dispatched through run_processing as a tool call with a real approval_callback. A score computed and acted on in plain code is not on that path.

known_failure_modes: credit scoring is an Annex III use, not a prohibited one; the finding says what co-occurred and the card decides the category
a risk score of a transaction is not a person score: the person noun is required on the same line or inside the same prompt literal
`approve_refund` is not a decision about a person; a decision function is reported only when its body names a person and no review symbol
findings.notes: an automated decision function names a person and no review or approval symbol in its body (EU-AIA-014a). Whether this practice falls under Art. 5, Art. 50 or Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 is a legal determination made by the operator, not a tool output. The finding reports what the code and the prompts say.

findings.title: No manipulation control on the response path

evidence.snippet: unit u1 takes user input, calls a model and carries person signals (profile_name), and no manipulation or disclosure control symbol appears in its code or co...

recommendation.summary: Put a manipulation and disclosure control on the output stage and measure it: ManipulationGuard flags influence tactics, AIDisclosureGuard flags human claims.
alternatives: aisafe ManipulationGuard and AIDisclosureGuard on output, then aisafe measure
LLM Guard output scanners for banned topics plus a judge
a human-reviewed sample of transcripts per week

package.leaves_open: Both guards are regex tables with an optional judge and ship UNMEASURED; they lower the odds that a manipulative response reaches the user and do nothing about the prompt or the ranking logic that produced it.

known_failure_modes: a control outside the tree (a gateway, vendor moderation) is invisible
presence of the symbol is checked, not that it sits on the response path
fires only in a unit that also carries a profile, engagement or persona signal, so a neutral assistant without one is not reported here
findings.notes: unit u1 takes user input, calls a model and carries person signals (profile_name), and no manipulation or disclosure control symbol appears in its code or config. Whether this practice falls under Art. 5, Art. 50 or Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 is a legal determination made by the operator, not a tool output. The finding reports what the code and the prompts say.
